---
title: "Editable supplementary figures"
format: html
---

Build an editable-caption DOCX from the verified supplementary PDF. Artwork is
unchanged; captions are extracted as native text with title and panel emphasis.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json, re, subprocess, sys
import pdfplumber
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Inches, Pt
from PIL import Image

src=Path(sys.argv[1]); out=Path(sys.argv[2]); out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
doc=Document(); sec=doc.sections[0]
sec.page_width=Inches(8.27); sec.page_height=Inches(11.69)
sec.top_margin=sec.bottom_margin=Inches(.5)
sec.left_margin=sec.right_margin=Inches(.5)
style=doc.styles['Normal']; style.font.name='Arial'; style.font.size=Pt(10)
style.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(0)
style.paragraph_format.line_spacing=1.08
records=[]
with pdfplumber.open(src) as pdf:
    for i,page in enumerate(pdf.pages):
        lines=page.extract_text_lines()
        cap=next(x for x in lines if re.match(r'^Figure S\d+:',x['text']))
        caption=' '.join(x['text'] for x in lines if x['top']>=cap['top']-.1 and x['bottom']<page.height-30)
        assert caption.startswith('Figure S')
        # Crop artwork only, excluding caption/footer. Preserve original pixels.
        p=PdfReader(src).pages[i]
        p.cropbox.lower_left=(30,page.height-cap['top']+6)
        p.cropbox.upper_right=(page.width-30,page.height-28)
        w=PdfWriter();w.add_page(p)
        artwork=out/f'figure-{i+1}.pdf'
        with artwork.open('wb') as f:w.write(f)
        subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-cropbox','-singlefile','-r','240','-png',str(artwork),str(artwork.with_suffix(''))],check=True,capture_output=True)
        if i:doc.add_page_break()
        pic=doc.add_paragraph();pic.paragraph_format.keep_with_next=True
        pic.paragraph_format.space_after=Pt(8)
        png=artwork.with_suffix('.png'); iw,ih=Image.open(png).size
        width=min(7.27,8.6*iw/ih)
        pic.add_run().add_picture(str(png),width=Inches(width))
        paragraph=doc.add_paragraph(); paragraph.paragraph_format.keep_together=True
        # PDF fonts supply exact title/panel emphasis, not inferred prose edits.
        chars=[c for c in page.chars if c['top']>=cap['top']-.1 and c['bottom']<page.height-30]
        for line in [x for x in lines if x['top']>=cap['top']-.1 and x['bottom']<page.height-30]:
            lc=sorted([c for c in chars if abs(c['top']-line['top'])<2],key=lambda c:c['x0'])
            last=None
            for c in lc:
                if last and c['x0']-last['x1']>1.5:paragraph.add_run(' ')
                r=paragraph.add_run(c['text']);r.bold='Bold' in c['fontname'];last=c
            paragraph.add_run(' ')
        assert re.sub(r'\s+',' ',paragraph.text).strip()==re.sub(r'\s+',' ',caption).strip(), (i,paragraph.text,caption)
        records.append({'page':i+1,'caption':caption,'artwork':str(png)})
doc.save(out/'Supplementary_figures_editable.docx')
(out/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source':str(src),'figures':records},indent=2))
print(out/'Supplementary_figures_editable.docx')
```
